items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: You know, one of the Joplin rags or James Scott or any of those things?

ctx.x: I don't think so. I should read so fast. I used to say, hold your conversation, put a piece of music in front of me and keep your conversation up. Now, I don't say it before. And I said, go ahead and talk to me, don't stop talking to me. People are listening to me. Part of me. After I found a guitar to be the hardest thing in the world to play, and then I stopped playing those things. After I found out everything else was a toy. After I found out all instruments was toys in comparison with a guitar, then I headed…
Can you play a rag, like Maple Leaf or anything like that, on that order on your guitar? You know, one of the Joplin rags or James Scott or any of those things?
I can play a rag. I've written a rag. I've written a lot of rags of my own. I used to play on stage, but I play on William. Well, we've got your C rag and E rag already.
